channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Demonstrators across Iran condemn US-Israeli war
item.description: Iranian media shared footage from several cities showing demonstrators condemning the US-Israeli war.

item.title: Iran’s succession question: Rouhani’s name resurfaces amid leadership void
item.description: Rouhani's legacy of pragmatism and moderation gains renewed relevance amid Iran's sensitive leadership transition phase.

item.title: Iranian rockets intercepted over central Israel
item.description: Interceptors were seen lighting up the sky over central Israel as sirens blared in response to Iranian rockets.

item.title: Who is choosing Iran’s next Supreme Leader?
item.description: Iran’s Assembly of Experts is now tasked with choosing the next Supreme Leader. It elected Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in 198

item.title: North Korea’s Kim oversees cruise missile tests from new naval destroyer
item.description: Kim Jong Un supervised the launch of sea-to-surface 'strategic cruise missiles' from country's new naval destroyer.

item.title: Canada PM Carney says unable to rule out military role in Iran war
item.description: Canadian leader also said the US-Israeli attacks on Iran appear to be 'inconsistent with international law'.

item.title: Video: Intense US-Israeli bombardment across Iran
item.description: Intense US-Israeli bombardment sent flames and plumes of smoke into the night sky across Iran.

item.title: Iran denies firing missile towards Turkiye after NATO interception
item.description: Turkiye's Defence Ministry had said a ⁠ballistic missile ⁠was destroyed ⁠by NATO over ‌the eastern Mediterranean.

item.title: Iran targets Kurdish groups in Iraq, begins wave of attacks on Israel
item.description: Iranian Kurdish armed groups have reportedly consulted with the US in recent days about whether to attack Iran.

item.title: China economic growth target set below 5% for the first time at key meeting
item.description: The National People's Congress set a GDP target of 4.5 to 5 percent for 2026 as China grapples with economic slowdown.
